answer.summary: All listed tests fail because the Spring context never starts. Spring Data rejects the new query PayloadIdentityRepository.findAllActionIdsByTenantIdWithOlderVersionsInUse as invalid SQL (JSqlParser error on "ANDi" at line 15, column 68). PayloadIdentityRepository is one of the files this change touched, so this is a deterministic break from the change, not a flake. Fix the query and re-run.
